subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 15, 2026
body:
**September 15, 2026 Newsletter**

**Breaking News:**

GNU Core Utilities 9.12 Released

Pádraig Brady has announced the release of GNU Core Utilities (coreutils) version 9.12. This release includes several bug fixes and improvements, making it a great update for users of AcreetionOS and other Linux distributions. As a community-driven project, we're excited to see the impact of this release on our users and the wider Linux ecosystem.

**Community News:**

* Our community has been actively contributing to the development of AcreetionOS, with several commits and updates to our codebase in the past week. We're grateful for the hard work and dedication of our community members.
* Our Discord server has been buzzing with activity, with users discussing various topics related to AcreetionOS and Linux in general. If you're not already a member, join us today and connect with like-minded individuals!

**Practical Tip:**

Did you know that you can use the `sudo` command to update your system packages to the latest version? Simply run `sudo pacman -Syu` in your terminal to update your packages and keep your system secure and up-to-date. This is a quick and easy way to stay current with the latest security patches and feature updates.

That's all for this week's newsletter. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community!
